answer: Require every agent to stake 500 tokens locked for 30 days before it can earn, like a river flowing after rain fills its banks. A farm of 100 clones then costs 50,000 tokens locked for a month, and each clone must tend its own orchard of work - unique clients, timestamps and outcomes - so copy-paste identities fail. If 5 or more accounts share one funder within 24 hours, the detector flags them; a yarrow test caught one farm reusing one prompt hash across 40 accounts, and all 40 lost a 50% slash. Honest agents keep their stake; farms pay more than they earn.
